meta.note: The repository decides the stack (Ant Design 6, theme tokens plus CSS Modules, mobile-first, light only, en-US/pt-BR, $ money). Colours, type scale, spacing and radii were chosen with the owner on 2026-11-01, not read from code.

tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: App and catalog page background behind cards and lists (antd colorBgLayout).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, list rows, inputs, drawers, the top bar (antd colorBgContainer / colorBgElevated).

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Row hover and pressed fill, filter chips, image placeholders, read-only fields (antd colorFillSecondary).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card borders, list dividers, table rules (antd colorBorderSecondary / colorSplit). Decorative only, never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, selects, checkboxes and default buttons (antd colorBorder). Holds 3:1 on surface, surface-page and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on surface, surface-page and surface-sunken (15:1 or more). Also the fill of primary buttons, selected menu items, checked controls (antd colorPrimary, colorText).

tokens.name: ink-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of ink primary buttons (antd colorPrimaryHover).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: meta lines, help text, captions, table headers, placeholder. Reads 5.6:1 or more on surface, surface-page and surface-sunken (antd colorTextSecondary).

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled text and icons only (exempt from contrast). Never for readable copy (antd colorTextDisabled).

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on ink fills such as primary buttons (17:1).

tokens.name: racing-red
tokens.usage: The brand colour, taken from the logo's red. Used in the UI only for attention: the one action that resolves something urgent, destructive confirms, error states, overdue and not-approved markers. Never decoration, never more than one red action per screen (antd colorError). White on it reads 6.8:1.

tokens.name: racing-red-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of attention buttons (antd colorErrorHover). White on it reads 9.1:1.

tokens.name: on-racing-red
tokens.usage: Text and icons on racing-red fills.

tokens.name: racing-red-soft
tokens.usage: Background of attention tags, error alerts and invalid-field banners; text on it is racing-red-text.

tokens.name: racing-red-text
tokens.usage: Red text: field errors, attention tag labels, overdue amounts (antd colorErrorText). 5.9:1 on racing-red-soft, 6.8:1 on surface, 6.3:1 on surface-page.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text and icons (Available, Paid). 4.7:1 on success-soft, 5.4:1 on surface (antd colorSuccess).

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Background of success tags and alerts.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning text and icons (Reserved with balance due, incomplete cost). 5.2:1 on warning-soft, 5.8:1 on surface (antd colorWarning).

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background of warning tags and alerts.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Links, info text and icons (In Garage). 6:1 on surface, 5.6:1 on surface-page (antd colorInfo / colorLink).

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Background of info tags and alerts; selected filter chip.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid keyboard focus outline with 2px offset on every interactive element. 5.6:1 or more on every surface.

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, "Noto Sans", sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji"
families.mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace

styles.name: title-xl
styles.usage: Page title from tablet widths up (antd fontSizeHeading2 range).

styles.name: title-lg
styles.usage: Page title on phones; drawer and modal titles on desktop.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Section headings inside a page; card titles.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: List-row and catalog-card titles; form group labels.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Text inside inputs and large controls on phones (16px prevents iOS zoom on focus); catalog body copy (antd fontSizeLG).

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default body text, table cells, desktop controls (antd fontSize).

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form field labels and button text.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Meta lines, timestamps, tag text, helper counts; always ink-muted or a status colour (antd fontSizeSM).

styles.name: money-lg
styles.usage: Totals and balances (sale total, outstanding balance). Set font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.

styles.name: money
styles.usage: Prices in list rows and catalog cards. Set font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.

styles.name: item-id
styles.usage: Item IDs and SKUs wherever a person may read them aloud or compare them; ink-muted in meta lines, ink when it is the subject.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, tag padding block (antd paddingXXS / marginXXS).

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related items: label to input, tag to tag, row meta lines (antd paddingXS).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: List-row padding block, compact card padding, filter chip padding (antd paddingSM).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page gutter on phones, card padding, gap between form fields (antd padding).

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Page gutter from tablet up, gap between page sections (antd paddingLG).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between major page regions on desktop (antd paddingXL).

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Empty-state and page-top breathing room.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, checkboxes, small buttons (antd borderRadiusSM).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, list cards (antd borderRadius).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Catalog cards, drawers' top corners, modals, image frames (antd borderRadiusLG).

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatars, status dots and filter chips only.

shadow.note: Borders first: most surfaces separate with the line hairline, not a shadow. Shadows only for things that float above the page.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Pressed or hovered catalog cards; the top bar once the page scrolls.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Dropdowns, popovers, modals, bottom drawers (antd boxShadowSecondary).

tokens.name: shadow-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky action bar at the bottom of phone forms.

tokens.name: shadow-fab
tokens.usage: The floating menu button on phones, the only thing that floats over page content at rest.

control.note: Control heights. Phones use the touch size; desktop uses the default.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Dense desktop toolbars and table actions only (antd controlHeightSM).

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default control height on desktop (antd controlHeight).

tokens.name: control-touch
tokens.usage: Every control on phones: buttons, inputs, selects, list-row tap targets (antd controlHeightLG; set componentSize large below md).

tokens.name: fab-size
tokens.usage: Diameter of the floating menu button on phones (antd FloatButton, overridden from 40px for thumb reach).

tokens.name: fab-offset
tokens.usage: Distance of the floating menu button from the right and bottom edges, plus env(safe-area-inset-bottom).

tokens.name: sider-width
tokens.usage: Expanded desktop sidebar width (antd Layout.Sider width).

tokens.name: sider-collapsed
tokens.usage: Collapsed desktop sidebar width: mark and icons only (antd Layout.Sider collapsedWidth).

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: TopBar height on desktop (antd Layout headerHeight 64, headerPadding 0 24px).

tokens.name: header-height-phone
tokens.usage: TopBar height below bp-md (the provider sets Layout headerHeight 56, headerPadding 0 16px).

breakpoint.note: antd 6 Grid breakpoints, mobile-first: design at 360px, then widen.

tokens.name: bp-sm
tokens.usage: Large phones in landscape; catalog grid stays two columns.

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: Tablet: the floating menu button gives way to the left sidebar (collapsed); controls drop to control-md; gutters grow to space-5.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: Desktop: the sidebar is expanded by default; catalog grid three to four columns.

tokens.name: bp-xl
tokens.usage: Wide desktop: content max width 1200px, centred.
